svg.title: A full corner determines the standard upper algebra
svg.desc: For P inside Q inside R on a standard space, compression gives a faithful normal expectation. The conditions on e imply P prime inside J R J and equality of their e corners. Full central support in P prime supplies bounded finite cutoffs converging strongly to one. These recover every operator from the corner and prove J R J equals P prime, hence R equals J P prime J.
svg.text: A full corner determines the upper algebra
P ⊂ Q ⊂ R; Q standard on H, JQJ = Q′
e ∈ R ∩ P′; P = Q ∩ {e}′; Pe = eRe
z of e in P′ = 1; JeJ = e
No factor, trace, finite-index or state assumption
Compression gives E: Q → P
θ(p) = pe is faithful and normal; E(x) = θ⁻¹(exe)
E is normal, completely positive, unital and faithful
Conjugation compares two commutant algebras
A = P′ ⊂ B = JRJ; e ∈ A has full central support
eBe = J(eRe)J ⊂ eQ′e ⊂ eAe ⊂ eBe
Therefore eBe = eAe
Bounded finite cutoffs recover each x ∈ B
T = Σ ueu*; h = T(T + ε1)⁻¹; 0 ≤ h ≤ 1
h = Σ aᵤeaᵤ*; aᵤ = (T + ε1)⁻¹ᐟ²u
hxh = Σ aᵤ[e(aᵤ*xaᵥ)e]aᵥ* ∈ A
h → 1 strongly; ‖hxh‖ ≤ ‖x‖; hence x ∈ A
P′ = JRJ; R = JP′J = ⟨Q,e⟩
The corner witnesses the algebra in its standard position
